purpose: Authoritative registry for historical Taiwan price sources. Registration is not activation; a source may enter StockLab only after the actual subscription/licence and delivery rights are verified.

ogdl_daily_forward_archive.note: The open-data daily snapshot is archived from the date StockLab started collecting it. It does not create earlier historical OHLC that was never obtained.

activation_requirements: user or operator explicitly subscribes to the external-use product
applicable online ordering terms are accepted and retained
delivery files are ingested privately with provenance and checksums
raw rows are not publicly redistributed beyond the contract scope

tpex_eshop_afterhours_history.product: 盤後資料 API / historical data
activation_requirements: subscription/order and member terms are explicitly completed
exact purchased product fields and historical range are verified
delivery is ingested privately with provenance and checksums
use is limited to the rights granted by the order terms
